BgAlpha.ts: (v) => `${v}%${v === 0 ? " · clear" : v === 100 ? " · solid" : v === DEFAULTS.bgAlpha ? " · default" : ""}`
BgAlpha.js: ((v) => `${v}%${v === 0 ? " · clear" : v === 100 ? " · solid" : v === DEFAULTS.bgAlpha ? " · default" : ""}`)

items.label: Provider · all songs
items.desc: Where lyrics come from. Auto picks the best-timed source; pick one to always try it first.
items.hintExpr: lyricSource ? `now showing ${lyricSource.provider} ${tierDots(lyricSource.tier)}` : "Auto picks the best-timed lyrics"

items.label: Provider · this song
items.desc: Same as above, for the song playing now only.
items.hintExpr: track ? `${track.title} · Auto follows the choice above` : "nothing playing"

items.label: Offset · all songs
items.desc: Lyrics running ahead or behind? Shift them later (+) or earlier (−) for every song. On the widget: [ and ].

items.label: Offset · this song
items.desc: Same, for this song only; added to the all-songs offset. On the widget: ⇧ with [ and ], \ resets.

items.label: Auto sync after scrolling
items.desc: After you scroll the lyrics, jump back to the line being sung this long after you stop. 0 turns it off.

items.label: Follow speed
items.desc: How long the list takes to glide to the next line.
